note: The experiment script tools/gate8c1/groupnorm_stat_probe.py wrote every machine-readable output (config, run_started, results, invariants, counts, z_profiles, groupnorm_statistics, uniform_control, predictions) and then raised TypeError in its own final matplotlib call, because case 00889 has z slices with zero valid voxels and therefore an undefined scored fraction.
resolution: The experiment script was left byte-unchanged so its recorded sha256 stays valid. comparison.png is rendered by tools/gate8c1/groupnorm_stat_probe_figure.py, which only reads results.json and z_profiles.csv and performs no inference.
